posts.community: Highness Microelectronics Ltd: a SMILE-type opportunity in electronics manufacturing?
posts.text: The CFO has responded to my questions, but the answers are rather vague for the most part. I see that the director remuneration in FY25 and 9M FY26 stand at approx. 18% of the PAT. I just want to make sure that there was a board approval for that. Kindly share that reference with me. Yes, the director remuneration was approved through the appropriate corporate governance process and is within the framework of the Companies Act, the Company’s remuneration policy and applicable approvals 2. What amount remains receivable from Aerohaste? How much has been collected since March 2026, and have all…
